in_sanskrit.name: Adiarth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beginning, Primordial
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Adiarth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Adiarth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'adi' meaning 'beginning' or 'primordial' and 'arth' meaning 'meaning' or 'goal'. This name is often given to children born into families that value tradition and the wisdom of the past.
